 Harmanpreet Kaur moves up to eighth in ICC ODI rankings
 SECTIONS Harmanpreet Kaur moves up to eighth in ICC ODI rankings PTI Last Updated: Oct 27, 2026, 02:30:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Harmanpreet Kaur has moved up to eighth position in the latest ICC Women's ODI rankings. Smriti Mandhana has lost her top ranking to Laura Wolvaardt after disappointing scores against Zimbabwe. In the same series, both Kaur and Deepti Sharma scored centuries to secure their team's victory. Deepti Sharma has also risen in the rankings, being placed among top all-rounders.
 PTI Harmanpreet breaks down after statement knock against Zim; says spent 5 hours daily at nets Dubai: Former India captain Harmanpreet Kaur on Tuesday gained two places to be eighth in the latest ICC Women's ODI rankings .
 However, current skipper Smriti Mandhana lost her top position to South Africa captain Laura Wolvaardt after scores of 32 and 0 in the recent fixtures against Zimbabwe.
In the second ODI against the African nation, Harmanpreet and all-rounder Deepti Sharma scored a century each to give their team an unassailable lead in the three-match series. Harmanpreet had stepped down from captaincy after leading the team to a second successive Asian Games gold in Japan. 
Deepti gained four positions to jump to 23rd in the batters' list and also gained two places to be fourth in the all-rounders' rankings. In the bowlers' list too, she moved up a spot to be eighth, the ICC stated.
There is also a new career-best ranking for India youngster Pratika Rawal (up seven rungs to 21st) in the list for ODI batters, while Zimbabwe trio Modester Mupachikwa (up five spots to 39th), Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano (up four slots to 47th), Beloved Biza (up 16 places to 56th) also made ground in this list.
 Live Events
In the updated T20I rankings, Shafali Verma (third) and Mandhana (fourth) gained one spot to go up in the list of batters.
